part.description: Protected rechargeable single-cell lithium-polymer pouch, 2000 mAh
part.sourcing: SparkFun currently excludes international battery shipping. LionCircuits lists this exact part in India but currently reports out of stock. Confirm availability and delivered dimensions before purchase.

connector.contactHeightBasis: Center of the C173752 supplier CAD contact blades, Z 3.875 to 4.450 mm in installed PCB coordinates.

leads.scope: Designed installation route, not a measured supplier cable. Wire diameter, exit positions, free lead length and bend radius require verification on the delivered pack.

charging.scope: Voltage and capacity selection match the 1-cell 4.2 V charger. Supplier maximum charge/discharge ratings and actual plug polarity remain sample qualification requirements.

modelScope: Dimensioned installation model with foil pouch, protected end, leads and keyed mating housing. Cosmetic pouch folds, tape and label are illustrative; this is not OEM CAD or a physical-fit certification.
